relationships.subject: Capsaicin
relationships.evidence_quote: Binding of CAP causes the opening of a channel in TRPV1 that conducts Ca2+ (and other cations, mainly Na+) into neurons

relationships.subject: NGF
relationships.evidence_quote: Acute re-introduction of NGF induced Ca<sup>2+</sup>-dependent CGRP exocytosis that was inhibited by botulinum neurotoxin type A (BoNT/A) or a chimera of/E and/A (/EA)

relationships.subject: NGF
relationships.evidence_quote: Acute exposure to NGF selectively enhanced CGRP release triggered by activation of TRPV1

relationships.subject: BoNT/A
relationships.evidence_quote: BoNT/A inhibited CGRP exocytosis evoked by low but not high CAP concentrations

relationships.subject: BoNT/EA chimera
relationships.evidence_quote: Notably, pre-treatment with/EA reduced the 1 µM CAP-evoked CGRP release from NGF starved cells (Figure 6E, grey bars), unlike BoNT/A.

relationships.subject: BoNT/A
relationships.evidence_quote: This exposure of TGNs to BoNT/A for 48h led to cleavage of ~75% of the SNAP-25 present

key_findings: NGF enhances capsaicin-evoked CGRP release from trigeminal neurons, mainly at low capsaicin concentrations, in a SNARE-dependent manner
BoNT/EA blocks CGRP release at high capsaicin and its NGF enhancement more effectively than BoNT/A
